label: Arduino UNO / compatible (ATmega328P)
notes: Compatible USB-serial boards may appear with Board Name Unknown.
Profile selection remains explicit rather than guessing from a serial chip.

label: Arduino Nano / compatible
notes: Some classic Nano clones may require processor-specific upload options; BetterBoard does not guess those yet.

label: Arduino Mega 2560 / compatible
notes: Initial recipes are authored against the UNO pin conventions; review pin assignments before using non-UNO boards.

label: ESP32 Dev Module (generic)
notes: Use only when the board is a classic ESP32-compatible Dev Module or when the exact vendor profile maps to this FQBN.
GPIO logic is 3.3 V; do not assume 5 V tolerance.
BetterBoard keeps the profile explicit because USB serial identity alone does not reliably identify the MCU variant.

label: ESP32-S3 Dev Module (generic)
notes: Generic Arduino-ESP32 S3 profile; vendor boards can require a more specific FQBN or USB option.
GPIO logic is 3.3 V and the safe pin map is board-specific.

label: ESP32-C3 Dev Module (generic)
notes: Generic Arduino-ESP32 C3 profile; ESP32-C3 is single-core, so multicore experiments must be interpreted as grouped/task execution only.
GPIO logic is 3.3 V and the safe pin map is board-specific.
